explorer_list(path, show_hidden) and explorer_drives() accept any absolute/UNC path from the window with no scope check; whole-disk browsing is required by R5, so no allow-list is possible here.
reloadShown (Show hidden / refresh) fires one explorerApi.list per currently expanded folder concurrently, uncapped and with no timeout; each scan is capped at 1000 returned / 10000 scanned.
names/paths are rendered only as React text and title attributes (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML), and detectKind is called without content, so listing never reads file contents.
CSP is unchanged (default-src 'self', no unsafe-eval, no remote scripts) and capabilities stay windows ["main"] + core:default + dialog:allow-open.
list_level_with opens std::fs::read_dir on every returned folder (line 123) to set Entry.locked, so listing one level touches each child directory.
FileRow is memo() but App passes a fresh inline onOpenFile (App.tsx:537), so the memo never bails and every row re-renders on App updates.
App's resetKey = view|selectedAppId|activePath (App.tsx:377); the reset effect (line 127) clears expanded folders on any active-tab change, not only a root change.
its git and app.up wait tests spawn real processes with 15s/60s limits (engine.rs:904,931,1055) and flake when the machine is loaded.
git calls are capped at 15s (TIMEOUT, git.rs:16) so a loaded machine can fail git_methods_work_through_the_engine and git::tests::a_plain_folder_is_not_a_repository (git.rs:598).
R3 click tests open a new/already-open file but never assert other tabs survive or that no save/write happens.
list_level_with never probes child folders; Entry.locked is always false for listed rows and Listing.locked is learned/set only when that folder's own level is requested.
unchanged; explorer_list/explorer_drives are app commands under core:default + dialog:allow-open, no new capability, windows still ["main"].
the only unsafe is the GetLogicalDrives Win32 FFI at line 147; no shell, no child process, no file contents read.
list_level caps at MAX_RETURNED 1000 rows / MAX_SCANNED 10000 entries and never recurses, so one call's work is bounded.
both commands run on tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking and have no timeout; a stalled network path holds a blocking thread.
ExplorerPanel opens files only through editor.openPath -> editor_open_any (existing path), not a new read command.
the new test runs `icacls` with fixed literal args (no outside input) to deny then remove a temp-folder ACL.
